CustomField.formula: IF(TEXT(Status__c) = "Leave", "🏖️ On Leave", IF(ISBLANK(Check_In_Time__c), "⚠️ Missing Check-in", IF(TEXT(Status__c) = "Late", "⏰ Late Check-in", IF(TEXT(Work_Location__c) = "Work from Home", "🏠 Work From Home", IF(TEXT(Work_Location__c) = "Work from office", "🏢 Work From Office", TEXT(Work_Location__c))))))
CustomField.label: Daily Status
